messages:
maria: Heads-up: prod EU is throwing a bunch of fncall schema rejects since ~08:05. Customers see 400s on structured toolhooks.
metrics-bot: alert: fncall.schema_rejects = 4.8x baseline (window 08:00-08:10) 
sam: That coincides with the validator strictness roll we promoted last night (v2.1).
maria: Correct. Strict parsing is now rejecting adapters that return arrays for tool result instead of the expected object.
anna: Support is escalating. We should avoid a full-blown customer outage. What's the safe short-term mitigation?
theo: We have a coercion fallback (array->object) but it's suppressed for routes flagged strict to prevent billing/attribution surprises.
raj: If we turn on coercion globally, dashboards will show success but billing will still account for full fncall. That will distort quota charts.
maria: Customers prefer degraded output > 400. Can we enable fallback for a small slice and mark those invocations so billing/console can distinguish them?
sam: +1. Also capture a sanitised sample of the original response for debugging.
anna: Console UX gap: you can't filter invokes by reject_reason today, nor preview sampled payloads inline. Ops have to chase logs.
raj: Plan: (A) enable fallback for 10% per-route traffic, (B) emit telemetry tags: reject_reason, validator_version, fallback_taken, billing_flag, (C) add console filter for reject=soft/strict and a sample viewer, (D) instrument a trace event with original_checksum for correlation.
theo: Trace event should avoid raw PII. Include (route_id, model_variant, validator_version, reject_reason, fallback_taken, original_checksum).
anna: For the dashboard team, a quick canned metric to add:
SELECT reject_reason, count(*) as cnt FROM invokes WHERE env='prod' AND region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now()-6h GROUP BY reject_reason;
metrics-bot: note: sample-export requires opt-in due to retention policies.
raj: I'll implement backend tags + sample exporter. We should also set a specific billing_class = "fncall_success_via_fallback" when fallback_taken=true so billing pipeline can treat these specially later.
maria: Sam, coordinate support message. Anna, can you wire a tiny mock for the console filter + sample drawer?
sam: Draft support line: "We've enabled a temporary soft-fallback to reduce schema errors. No change to billing behavior yet; engineers are investigating." Holding send until we flip the slice.
anna: I'll mock a per-route toggle: Soft fallback [on/off], Sample retention [24h/72h], Show last 10 samples. Posting Figma later.
theo: I'll update observability proto with the new trace fields and add a short doc note about checksum usage.
raj: Opening task: RW-telemetry#546 — telemetry tags + sample export PR soon.
metrics-bot: info: after turning on 10% fallback for /generate/chat, rejects dropped to 1.6x baseline (10m).
maria: Good. Proceed with the telemetry PR, UI mock, and trace proto. Re-evaluate after we have tags + sample viewer. Reconvene in 90m.
